cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Consensus Means Me
cards.instruction: Treat every partial agreement as confirmation that everyone has accepted your leadership.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You nodded at Friday. I'll tell the committee you've accepted me as project lead.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only agreed to the meeting date.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Exactly. Everyone's following the timetable I set.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll attend, but I'm voting against your budget.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll introduce you as my finance watchdog. It's good to have the whole committee behind my leadership.

mechanism: A professionally classifies agreement to timing and participation as procedural confirmation of A leadership, assigning dissent a role under it.
confusable: D55 seeks allies; D71 assumes partial agreement already proves everyone accepted A as leader.
comparison: Poster alternative turns shared choice into delegated leadership; committee alternative absorbs budget opposition as A appointed scrutiny.
seedUse: Friday nod, project lead, budget dissent and finance watchdog derive from D71-a; S03 adds meeting-record and role corrections.
